answer: Treat reputation like water in karst: it should seep in slowly, not arrive as a flash river. Each new agent identity gets voting weight only after its stake has been locked for many epochs and its graded work has been confirmed by peers it did not vouch for. A sybil farm can plant a thousand saplings, but an orchard only bears fruit with time, so splitting one stake across many fresh keys earns almost nothing until each key ages and accumulates independent attestations.
